post.description: Account-authenticated Boat commands. Creation queues execution with output capture already configured. Attach reads saved output and never starts or cancels work. Poll from the returned byte offsets; each request checks current authority. No URL tokens. Unknown execution is never replayed. Output expires seven days after creation; each stream retains its first 256 KiB and reports discarded bytes with gaps. Cancellation is intent until an observed exit. Origin, if supplied, must match this deployment.
